title: The Imposter
tagline: Online party game: one of you doesn't know the word. Find them.
description: Make a room, share the 4-letter code and play with friends online. Everyone gets the same secret Python word except one player: the imposter. Give clues that fit without giving it away, then vote the imposter out. (Rooms, lobby and secret roles are live; clue and vote rounds are coming next.)
